name.en-US: Memoranda on War and Peace, and Plans of Government

author.fr-FR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.en-US: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.pt-BR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon

description.fr-FR: Les mémoires politiques de Fénelon : sur les moyens de prévenir la guerre de la succession d’Espagne, sur la situation de la France et sur la paix, sur Cambrai ; les Plans de gouvernement concertés avec le duc de Chevreuse (les Tables de Chaulnes, 1711) ; et les mémoires sur les précautions à prendre après la mort du duc de Bourgogne (régence, éducation du jeune prince).
description.en-US: Fénelon’s political memoranda: on the means of preventing the War of the Spanish Succession, on the situation of France and on peace, on Cambrai; the Plans of Government drawn up with the Duke of Chevreuse (the Tables of Chaulnes, 1711); and the memoranda on the precautions to take after the death of the Duke of Burgundy (the regency, the education of the young prince).
description.pt-BR: Os memoriais políticos de Fénelon: sobre os meios de evitar a guerra da sucessão da Espanha, sobre a situação da França e sobre a paz, sobre Cambrai; os Planos de governo concertados com o duque de Chevreuse (as Tábuas de Chaulnes, 1711); e os memoriais sobre as precauções a tomar após a morte do duque de Borgonha (regência, educação do jovem príncipe).

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 7, p. 180–; archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
